statements.status_notes: The advisory applies to Mbed TLS 2.7.0 and earlier TLS-ECDH-RSA certificate validation behavior. This package ships mbedtls 3.6.5; Debian marks the issue unfixed with no security impact (https://github.com/ARMmbed/mbedtls/issues/1561).

CVE-2025-66442 is a compiler-induced timing side channel that only occurs when Mbed TLS is built with LLVM select-optimize. Debian builds mbedtls with GCC, and the Debian security tracker notes mbedtls is not built with clang in Debian.

Upstream Mbed TLS 3.6.6 fixes the x509_inet_pton_ipv6 buffer underread (commit 4595bb47d27c2aae522c54eca28605f270ab5f5a). Applied in package/deb/main/mbedtls patch/CVE-2026-25833.patch on the 3.6.5-0.1~deb13u1+dhi1 rebuild.
